notes.zh: 线框查看新增单个/多个 ID、全选反选与上一项/下一项快捷键；按文件名沿用线框版本，切换 ID 自动适应场景，修复画面空白。包含 1.6.5 文档与术语修订。
notes.en: Add single/multiple wireframe IDs, select all/invert and previous/next shortcuts. Remember variants by filename and fit newly selected IDs to avoid empty views. Includes 1.6.5 terminology and guide updates.
